title: edf uk government agree extend life sizewell b nuclear plant by 20 years 2026 07 08
text:
LONDON, July 8 (Reuters) - French power company EDF and the British government have signed an agreement to extend the life of the ​Sizewell B nuclear power plant in Suffolk, England, by 20 ‌years to 2055, they said on Wednesday.
